capabilities: Mount a Google Drive folder as the vault backend
Serve vault files from an in-memory and IndexedDB cache
Upload rapid edits via a single debounced request
Poll remote Drive changes and reconcile them into the vault and open editors
Sign in with Google on desktop or via an auth bundle on mobile
disambiguation: Not a viewer for Drive files; it replaces the vault's storage adapter so a Google Drive folder acts as the vault itself.
extras: Setup involves manually building the plugin and copying main.js and manifest.json into the vault's plugin directory; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian vaults are local folders, so using a Google Drive folder as the vault storage with fast access and cross-device sync is not supported natively.

relations.evidence: mounts a Google Drive folder as a virtual vault backend

summary: Mounts a Google Drive folder as the vault backend, serving files through an in-memory and IndexedDB cache on desktop and mobile.
